ev:rule:R1.title: Transfer rule R1: Registry design and natural history protocol
ev:rule:R1.note: High phenotype similarity: transferable. Medium: needs expert review. Mechanism does not matter.

ev:rule:R2.title: Transfer rule R2: Outcome measures and endpoints
ev:rule:R2.note: Same as R1, and always flag age of onset and severity for review.

ev:rule:R3.title: Transfer rule R3: Clinical network, sites and investigators
ev:rule:R3.note: Medium or higher phenotype similarity, or a shared investigator: transferable.

ev:rule:R4.title: Transfer rule R4: Therapeutic strategy and modality
ev:rule:R4.note: Same road: needs expert review, with the modality named. Opposite direction: do not transfer (explicit warning). Unknown or contested: needs expert review, stating what must be established first.

ev:rule:R5.title: Transfer rule R5: Disease models and assays
ev:rule:R5.note: The model itself is gene-specific: do not transfer. The assay design is reusable on the same road: needs expert review.

ev:rule:R6.title: Transfer rule R6: Trial design
ev:rule:R6.note: Same road and high phenotype similarity: needs expert review. Otherwise: do not transfer.

ev:rule:R7.title: Transfer rule R7: Enrolment in the neighbor's trial
ev:rule:R7.note: Never asserted. Show the trial's eligibility excerpt and tell the family to ask the study team.
